title: Ancient Shiva Temple Bhainsdehi
visualBrief: Ancient Shiva Temple Bhainsdehi, pictured2013 standing state: raised coursed stone platform/central approach, open carved square-pier hall with modern shallow sheet shelter, broken front carved stumps, low rear sanctuary with real doorway and receding corbel ceiling. Small original simplified Nandi/lingam silhouettes; no copied religious sculpture, inscriptions or photographic atlas. No invented complete shikhara.
